dataset: Our World in Data CO2 (pinned commit, see data/README.md)

questions.question: What were India's CO2 emissions in 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'India' AND e.year = 2020

questions.question: What was the population of Brazil in 2010?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT i.population FROM country_indicators i JOIN countries c ON c.id = i.country_id WHERE c.name = 'Brazil' AND i.year = 2010

questions.question: What were the World's total CO2 emissions in 2015?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'World' AND e.year = 2015

questions.question: What were Germany's CO2 emissions per capita in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.co2_per_capita FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'Germany' AND e.year = 2022

questions.question: How much methane did the United States emit in 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT g.methane FROM ghg_emissions g JOIN countries c ON c.id = g.country_id WHERE c.name = 'United States' AND g.year = 2020

questions.question: How much CO2 did Japan emit from coal in 2019?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.coal_co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'Japan' AND e.year = 2019

questions.question: What was China's share of global CO2 emissions in 2023?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.share_global_co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'China' AND e.year = 2023

questions.question: What was the GDP of France in 2018?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT i.gdp FROM country_indicators i JOIN countries c ON c.id = i.country_id WHERE c.name = 'France' AND i.year = 2018

questions.question: What were the United Kingdom's cumulative CO2 emissions as of 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.cumulative_co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'United Kingdom' AND e.year = 2020

questions.question: What were Europe's CO2 emissions in 2021?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'Europe' AND e.year = 2021

questions.question: What was the average CO2 per capita across all countries in 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT avg(e.co2_per_capita) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2020

questions.question: How many countries emitted more than 100 million tonnes of CO2 in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND e.co2 > 100

questions.question: What were the total CO2 emissions of all countries combined in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT sum(e.co2) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022
alternatives: SELECT e.co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'World' AND e.year = 2022
ground_truth.note: Sum over countries, or the World row (which adds international aviation and shipping).

questions.question: What was the highest CO2 per capita of any country in 2021?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT max(e.co2_per_capita) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2021

questions.question: What was the smallest population of any country in 2023?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT min(i.population) FROM country_indicators i JOIN countries c ON c.id = i.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND i.year = 2023

questions.question: How many countries are in the database?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM countries WHERE entity_type = 'country'

questions.question: What were India's average annual CO2 emissions from 2010 to 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT avg(e.co2) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'India' AND e.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020

questions.question: What were the United States' total CO2 emissions summed over 2000 to 2009?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT sum(e.co2) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'United States' AND e.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009

questions.question: In how many years did China emit more than 10,000 million tonnes of CO2?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'China' AND e.co2 > 10000

questions.question: What was the median CO2 per capita among countries in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.co2_per_capita) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022

questions.question: Which 5 countries emitted the most CO2 in 2023?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2023 AND e.co2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.co2 DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which 3 countries had the highest CO2 emissions per capita in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND e.co2_per_capita IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.co2_per_capita DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which 5 countries had the lowest CO2 emissions per capita in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND e.co2_per_capita IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.co2_per_capita ASC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which country had the largest population in 2023?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM country_indicators i JOIN countries c ON c.id = i.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND i.year = 2023 AND i.population IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.population DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which 5 countries had the highest methane emissions in 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM ghg_emissions g JOIN countries c ON c.id = g.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND g.year = 2020 AND g.methane IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.methane DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which 10 countries have the highest cumulative CO2 emissions as of 2023?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2023 AND e.cumulative_co2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.cumulative_co2 DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Which 3 countries emitted the most CO2 from oil in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND e.oil_co2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.oil_co2 DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which continent had the highest CO2 emissions in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name IN ('Africa', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'North America', 'Oceania', 'South America') AND e.year = 2022 ORDER BY e.co2 DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which 5 countries had the highest GDP in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM country_indicators i JOIN countries c ON c.id = i.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND i.year = 2022 AND i.gdp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.gdp DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Rank the World Bank income groups by CO2 per capita in 2020, highest first.

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'income_group' AND e.year = 2020 ORDER BY e.co2_per_capita DESC

questions.question: How did India's CO2 emissions change year by year from 2015 to 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.year, e.co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'India' AND e.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 ORDER BY e.year

questions.question: Show China's CO2 per capita for each year from 2000 to 2010.

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.year, e.co2_per_capita FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'China' AND e.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 ORDER BY e.year

questions.question: What were the World's CO2 emissions in each year from 2019 to 2023?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.year, e.co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'World' AND e.year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 ORDER BY e.year

questions.question: How did the United Kingdom's CO2 emissions from coal change each year from 2010 to 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.year, e.coal_co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'United Kingdom' AND e.year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020 ORDER BY e.year

questions.question: In which year did the United States have its highest CO2 emissions?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.year FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'United States' AND e.co2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.co2 DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Germany's population in 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT i.year, i.population FROM country_indicators i JOIN countries c ON c.id = i.country_id WHERE c.name = 'Germany' AND i.year IN (1990, 2000, 2010, 2020) ORDER BY i.year

questions.question: By how many million tonnes did China's CO2 emissions grow from 2000 to 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT max(e.co2) FILTER (WHERE e.year = 2020) - max(e.co2) FILTER (WHERE e.year = 2000) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'China'

questions.question: By what percentage did World CO2 emissions change in 2023 compared with 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.co2_growth_prct FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'World' AND e.year = 2023

questions.question: In which year were the World's methane emissions highest?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT g.year FROM ghg_emissions g JOIN countries c ON c.id = g.country_id WHERE c.name = 'World' AND g.methane IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.methane DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show France's CO2 per capita every 5 years from 1990 to 2020.

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.year, e.co2_per_capita FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.name = 'France' AND e.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2020 AND e.year % 5 = 0 ORDER BY e.year

questions.question: Which countries had CO2 per capita above 15 tonnes and a population above 10 million in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id JOIN country_indicators i ON i.country_id = e.country_id AND i.year = e.year WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND e.co2_per_capita > 15 AND i.population > 10000000

questions.question: Which countries emitted more than 500 million tonnes of CO2 from coal in 2022, from highest to lowest?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND e.coal_co2 > 500 ORDER BY e.coal_co2 DESC

questions.question: Which countries emitted between 400 and 600 million tonnes of CO2 in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND e.co2 BETWEEN 400 AND 600

questions.question: Among countries that emitted over 100 million tonnes of CO2 in 2022, which emitted more CO2 from gas than from oil?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND e.co2 > 100 AND e.gas_co2 > e.oil_co2

questions.question: How many countries had CO2 per capita below 1 tonne in 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2020 AND e.co2_per_capita < 1

questions.question: Among countries with more than 100 million people in 2022, which 5 had the lowest CO2 per capita?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id JOIN country_indicators i ON i.country_id = e.country_id AND i.year = e.year WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND i.population > 100000000 AND e.co2_per_capita IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.co2_per_capita ASC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What was the average CO2 per capita of countries with more than 50 million people in 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT avg(e.co2_per_capita) FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id JOIN country_indicators i ON i.country_id = e.country_id AND i.year = e.year WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2020 AND i.population > 50000000
alternatives: SELECT sum(e.co2) / sum(i.population) * 1000000 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id JOIN country_indicators i ON i.country_id = e.country_id AND i.year = e.year WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2020 AND i.population > 50000000 AND e.co2 IS NOT NULL
ground_truth.note: Simple mean of country values, or population-weighted (total CO2 / total population).

questions.question: Which countries increased their CO2 emissions by more than 10% in 2022 while emitting over 50 million tonnes?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2022 AND e.co2_growth_prct > 10 AND e.co2 > 50

questions.question: In 2020, which countries' methane emissions exceeded their nitrous oxide emissions by more than 300 million tonnes of CO2-equivalent?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM ghg_emissions g JOIN countries c ON c.id = g.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND g.year = 2020 AND g.methane - g.nitrous_oxide > 300

questions.question: Which World Bank income group had the highest total CO2 emissions in 2022?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id WHERE c.entity_type = 'income_group' AND e.year = 2022 ORDER BY e.co2 DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What were the CO2 emissions in 2020 of the 5 countries with the highest GDP that year?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name, e.co2 FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id JOIN country_indicators i ON i.country_id = e.country_id AND i.year = e.year WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2020 AND i.gdp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.gdp DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What were the total greenhouse gas emissions in 2022 of the 5 most populous countries?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name, g.total_ghg FROM ghg_emissions g JOIN countries c ON c.id = g.country_id JOIN country_indicators i ON i.country_id = g.country_id AND i.year = g.year WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND g.year = 2022 AND i.population IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.population DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What were India's CO2 emissions and methane emissions in 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT e.co2, g.methane FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id JOIN ghg_emissions g ON g.country_id = e.country_id AND g.year = e.year WHERE c.name = 'India' AND e.year = 2020

questions.question: Which countries emitted more than 1,000 million tonnes of CO2 and more than 300 million tonnes of CO2-equivalent methane in 2020?

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.name FROM co2_emissions e JOIN countries c ON c.id = e.country_id JOIN ghg_emissions g ON g.country_id = e.country_id AND g.year = e.year WHERE c.entity_type = 'country' AND e.year = 2020 AND e.co2 > 1000 AND g.methane > 300

questions.question: What were China's energy use per person and CO2 emissions per person in 2022?
